in_marathi.name: Budhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Budhi is a Sanskrit name that originates from the word ‘buddhi,’ meaning intellect or wisdom. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is often associated with the god of wisdom, Lord Budha. The name Budhi is believed to represent the inner wisdom and intelligence of an individual. It symbolizes the power of knowledge and understanding, as well as the ability to discern and make wise decisions.
